title: Saints G Cesar Ruiz wants to "change the narrative" after 2025 criticism

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Saints G Cesar Ruiz wants to "change the narrative" after 2025 criticism
sources.description: The Saints didn't make the playoffs in 2025, but their play in the second half of head coach Kellen Moore's first season in New Orleans created some positive buzz heading into the 2026 season.
